title: Narra 4.1.15
message: Comic issues, anime captions, download progress, and recommendations are more reliable in this release.
changelog: Comic details now merge native and hosted issue feeds instead of caching a single empty response.
Comic issue search remains visible, readable issues open in Narra, and official-source issues are clearly identified.
Saved comics and comic reading progress now appear in their own Library section.
Anime caption files use the working subtitle proxy path, restoring selectable captions when providers return them.
Anime recommendations combine AniList, Tenrai, and hosted results while isolating individual source failures.
Episode downloads show preparation and transfer progress immediately and block duplicate download requests.
Narra package, Profile, integrity check, release manifest, and APK are synchronized at build 21.
